svg.aria-label: AWS architecture for infra-at-scale: visitors resolve DNS via Route 53 and reach the frontend through WAF and CloudFront to S3, or the API through WAF and an Application Load Balancer into ECS Fargate backend and admin services running as blue/green pairs in private subnets, which read/write RDS Postgres via RDS Proxy and cache in ElastiCache Redis. A venue encoder pushes RTP into MediaLive, which writes HLS to S3 and is served by a second CloudFront distribution to viewers. GitHub Actions authenticates via OIDC and drives CodeDeploy to shift ALB traffic between blue and green target groups, with CloudWatch alarms feeding automatic rollback. KMS encrypts every data store, Secrets Manager holds every credential, and security groups restrict every tier to only the tier above it.
svg.text: Terraform module map, request flow & user interaction · one environment shown (dev/qa/staging/prod wire identically — see docs/02-module-connections.md)
*single shared NAT in dev/qa; one per AZ in staging/prod
ECS Fargate cluster (modules/ecs-cluster) · tasks run here, never on a public IP
modules/rds + modules/elasticache · reachable only from the ECS tasks' security group (modules/security-groups)
Live streaming pipeline (modules/live-streaming) · decoupled from the VPC
Security, secrets, observability & state — spans every module above
